verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing and viewing one-time passwords, but nothing in the evidence shows codes generating offline or being viewable without a 1Password account. Community comments point the other way, noting the loss of local, non-cloud vault storage. Basic TOTP storage is adjacent to, not evidence of, offline account-free generation.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes
